To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a method for the reconstruction of an x-ray spectra of a plasma source is proposed, which allows one to improve the spectral resolution of the x-ray spectra by 2--5 times.

the method of reconstruction of the x-ray spectra of laser plasmas by the mathematical processing of experimental data was developed and applied to the reconstruction of the x-rays of the He-like ions Al XII and Si XIII.

the reconstruction of the x-ray spectra of a laser plasma is possible by mathematical processing of experimental data using a new method that requires less calculation time and ensures an improvement in spectral resolution by a 2--5 factor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method for the reconstruction of x-ray spectra broadened by the plasma source and the recording channel.

the development of a method for processing the experimental x-ray spectrum of laser plasma, which makes it possible to reconstruct the structure of the spectrum with a resolution that is comparable to that of the theoretical model.
the mathematical processing of x-ray spectra of laser plasmas.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the new method is more efficient than the previously used methods.

the method of reconstruction of the structure in the x-ray spectra of plasma sources based on the local regularization method with the numerical implementation of the method by means of a semigroup scheme provides the possibility of a more detailed reconstruction of the x-ray spectra and the determination of the structure of a plasma source.
this method is very promising and should be applied in other areas of physics and technology.

the new method is more effective for the processing of data on the x-ray spectra of a plasma source than the methods based on local regularization.

the new method is suitable for the reconstruction of a broadened x-ray spectrum in the range of 1--10 keV.
